sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector leadership remains narrow as only Technology and Communication Services hold all-green status, while Healthcare makes the sharpest short-term advance and Financials begin to fade.

Leadership is concentrated at the top, driven by Technology (momentum 0.883, YTD rank 2) and Communication Services (momentum 0.650, YTD rank 9), which represent the only 2 of 11 groups positive across all tracked timeframes. Energy continues to hold the top YTD spot with a 0.650 momentum score, while Healthcare is actively rotating higher, gaining 2 spots over the past 5 sessions to reach rank 5 with a strong 0.717 momentum score.

Conversely, defensive and cyclical laggards are softening further. Consumer Defensive fell 2 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 8 with weak momentum (0.283), joined at the bottom by Utilities (momentum 0.067, rank 10) and Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.300, rank 11). 

## Strength
- Narrow breadth persists, with only 2 of 11 sectors qualifying as all-green across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames.
- Technology dominates overall performance as an all-green leader, posting the market's highest momentum score at 0.883 and holding rank 2 YTD.
- Communication Services maintains all-green breadth with a 0.650 momentum score, despite a lower YTD rank of 9.

## Movers & Momentum
- Healthcare is the primary momentum gainer, advancing +2 spots over the past 5 sessions to rank 5 with a 0.717 momentum score.
- Real Estate edged up +1 spot over 5 sessions to rank 7, though underlying momentum remains low at 0.283.
- Utilities sits as the market's weakest momentum laggard at 0.067 (rank 10), alongside Consumer Cyclical at 0.300 (rank 11).
- Consumer Defensive posted the steepest drop, slipping -2 spots over the past 5 sessions to rank 8 with 0.283 momentum.

## Divergences
- Financials display a fading divergence, shedding -1 spot in rank over the last 5 sessions to sit at rank 6 despite an otherwise solid 0.617 momentum score.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Narrow market breadth persists with only 10 of 144 groups all-green, led by sustained strength in Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing and Marine Shipping, alongside accelerating momentum in Diagnostics & Research.

Leadership remains concentrated across energy, select tech hardware, and healthcare. Diagnostics & Research (+25 spots to rank 42) and Internet Content & Information (+17 spots to rank 52) are reinforcing their all-green status with sharp five-day rank improvements. Sustained multi-month outperformance continues in anchors like Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.970) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.917).

Meanwhile, industrial freight, communications, and consumer-facing groups are deteriorating rapidly. Integrated Freight & Logistics (-20 spots to rank 61) and Coking Coal (-23 spots to rank 106) saw heavy 5-day drops, while pockets of financial services like Insurance - Life and Banks - Regional are flashing early distribution signals.

## Strength
- **All-Green Breadth:** Only 10 of 144 industry groups are positive across all time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, YTD), including Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.97 momentum), Marine Shipping (0.92), and Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.91).
- **Sustained Leaders:** Core groups maintaining top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows include Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing, Marine Shipping, Consumer Electronics, Diagnostics & Research, Internet Content & Information, Health Information Services, Software - Infrastructure, and Insurance - Reinsurance.
- **Top Absolute Momentum:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.970, rank YTD 2) and Marine Shipping (0.917, rank YTD 5) hold the highest momentum scores across the board.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Improvers:** Diagnostics & Research surged +25 spots (rank 42, 0.89 momentum), followed by Airlines (+24 spots to rank 88, 0.63 momentum) and Specialty Industrial Machinery (+18 spots to rank 43, 0.60 momentum).
- **Sharpest Decliners:** Coking Coal dropped -23 spots (rank 106, 0.27 momentum), while Business Equipment & Supplies (-20 spots to rank 71, 0.44 momentum) and Integrated Freight & Logistics (-20 spots to rank 61, 0.36 momentum) fell sharply.
- **Persistent Laggards:** Weakness remains anchored in Mortgage Finance (0.054 momentum, rank YTD 142), Gambling (0.063 momentum, rank YTD 143), and Personal Services (0.106 momentum, rank YTD 138).

## Divergences
- **Fading High-Momentum Groups:** Prior leaders showing short-term slippage include Insurance - Life (0.71 momentum, -4 spots in 5d), Banks - Regional (0.63 momentum, -5 spots in 5d), and Oil & Gas Equipment & Services (0.63 momentum, -4 spots in 5d).
- **Emerging Low-Momentum Movers:** Early turnarounds advancing quickly despite low momentum profiles include Conglomerates (+15 spots in 5d, 0.48 momentum) and Utilities - Renewable (+15 spots in 5d, 0.38 momentum).
